backlog.title: Increase Warmup Ratio

backlog.spec: Change ADAM_BETAS from (0.8, 0.95) to (0.9, 0.95) to better absorb high-frequency gradients and reduce noise in early training.

backlog.title: Increase Embedding Learning Rate

backlog.spec: Wrap the residual addition (x + x_prev) inside each transformer block with torch.nn.LayerNorm before the matrix multiplication to capitalize on layer norms' speed and stability. Replace any direct `x + x_l` with `layer_norm(x) + x_l`.
backlog.title: Factorized Pre-Norm Residuals

backlog.spec: Instead of a fixed `max_grad_norm`, implement dynamic clipping where the norm is renormalized based on a moving average of gradients to prevent saturation in early steps and overfitting at the end.
backlog.title: Gradient Clipping Dynamic Threshold

backlog.spec: Apply dropout to the skip connections (residuals) at rate `drop_rate / total_steps * warmup_steps` so the model remains sparse during training and becomes dense at the end, enhancing generalization.
backlog.title: Stochastic Depth Decay

backlog.spec: Integrate a small internal state that averages the first several gradient updates before applying to the main model. This mimics a momentum like optimizer inside Adam, stabilizing the path.
backlog.title: Lookahead Accumulator

backlog.spec: During training, increment the `layer-scaling` factors at a different rate for different block types (e.g., fast for residual, slow for attention) to 'fine-tune' the layers in sequence.
backlog.title: Layer Scaling Variable Increments

backlog.spec: Enable gradient checkpointing at the mini-batch level in the forward pass. This is a lightweight, clean cost in gradient memory that reduces caching issues and VRR for the battery.
backlog.title: Mini-Batch Gradient Checkpointing

backlog.spec: Apply a time-varying multiplier to `bias` terms that decays exponentially over time, effectively boosting their importance early and reducing their impact later.
backlog.title: Time-Domain Bias Correction

backlog.spec: Add an extra, small attention mechanism that correlates features across the different scales used in the model, allowing the large base features to gain insight from the smaller ones.
backlog.title: Cross-Scale Attention

backlog.spec: Inject a low-rank Gaussian 'noise' into the gradient around each optimizer step, specifically targeting the hidden states, acting as a mini-batch regularization to avoid overfitting.
backlog.title: Denoising Gradient Injection

backlog.spec: Implement a warmup phase that ramps up slowly, pauses, and then ramps up again in a step-like fashion over time, rather than just linearly.
backlog.title: adaptive Warmup with Cycles
